verdict.rationale: Stripe documents ML-generated risk scores on every authorization, covering fraud risk, merchant dispute risk and card-testing detection, though the evidence comes from the agents page. It also documents real-time approve/decline via synchronous webhook and replacement of lost or stolen cards, so auth-time fraud signals and reissue are covered. Missing for 10: any evidence of suspicious-activity alerts or notifications to ops, explicit tooling to freeze or block a compromised card (only merchant/country spending controls and per-authorization declines are shown), network fraud scores, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
